mapcreator.reset.after_death: You died. The map was reset.
gui.ai.chat_lore: Ask Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini to set up the rule
gui.ai.title: AI assistant
gui.ai.key_warn: Stored in config/mapcreator-ai.json on the server computer. Never share that file.
gui.ai.key_prompt: Type the API key in chat (it is not shown to other players).
gui.ai.model_prompt: Type the model name in chat (e.g. claude-sonnet-5-5).
gui.ai.autorun_lore: Off: you confirm every AI proposal with a click
gui.ai.prompt: Type your message to the AI in chat.
gui.ai.no_key: No API key for %s. Set it in Settings -> AI assistant.
gui.npc.appear_lore: The NPC is spawned when the rule fires, instead of being there from the start
gui.ai.hint: Click Write a prompt and tell the AI what to build, e.g. when the player steps here, kill him with the text fell into the void and flip the camera for 10 seconds. The AI sees this whole editor and answers with blocks below.
gui.ai.block_lore: Click: apply | Shift- or right-click: remove
gui.ai.ready: The AI answered. Open Chat AI in the menu to see the blocks.
gui.ai.model_lore: Click: pick from the provider's list | Shift-click: type the name
gui.ai.err_timeout: Model %s did not answer in time. Pick a faster one (a flash or flash-lite model) in Settings -> AI assistant -> Model and try again.
gui.ai.err_quota: Quota exceeded for model %s. On the free plan many models (especially pro ones) have no quota: pick another (flash-lite or flash), wait a minute, or enable billing with your provider.
gui.ai.err_key: The API key was rejected. Check it in Settings -> AI assistant.
gui.ai.err_model: Model %s was not found. Pick one from the list in Settings -> AI assistant -> Model.
gui.cond.need: Condition: only if these scripts ran
gui.cond.forbid: Condition: only if these scripts did NOT run
gui.rules.clear_lore: The player drops nothing, the inventory is just cleared (like /clear)
